items.title: Danny Barker Interview (Louis Armstrong memorial broadcast), 1971-07-09
items.q: There was only one Caruso There was only one Einstein One Thomas Edison One Henry Ford I put him above all those people too

ctx.x: The woods stood still on Blueberry Hill And it wasn't until my dream come true Down when the willows played Love's sweet melody And all of those vows we made Were never to be Though we were born You followed me still Oh, you were my thrill On Blueberry Hill Come find your hill with me, baby We'll see what we will see I'll bring my heart with me I'll be with you where the fairies are blue Yes, each afternoon we'll go Yes, I've been a moon real good You are winning and you will go Yes, I've been a moon real good…

Because I think the people I think we ought to know something about you Your instrument Has your instrument always been the guitar Yes, I play guitar You know, play a little There's so much to learn about a guitar You know, and I start playing rhythm and bands and and getting in New York There's so many great guitar players if you want to jump in competition and try to I never aspired to be the greatest, you know, just went along and played And what would be your goal? What kind of goal have you established for…
We'll understand him better by by And he went on by and by Take it brother, Cat Lid
